import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from robomme_icl.suite import load_configs, plan_slots, candidate_for_slot, content_hash
reference=json.loads(Path("artifacts/reports/robomme-icl/geometry_preflight-v3.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
configs=load_configs()
slots=plan_slots(*configs)
by_id={slot["slot_id"]:slot for slot in slots}
rows=[]
for row in reference["slots"]:
    spec=candidate_for_slot(by_id[row["slot_id"]],row["accepted"]["candidate_index"])
    rows.append({"slot_id":row["slot_id"],"seed":spec.seed,"spec_hash":spec.spec_hash})
print(json.dumps({"python_hash_seed":os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"],"task_config_hash":content_hash(configs[0]),"position_config_hash":content_hash(configs[1]),"rows":rows},sort_keys=True))
